parole.testo: A word spread around the Baltic Sea languages, and since German has possessed this word only in the extreme fringe of its language area, as has Russian, it has traditionally been assumed that the Germans have borrowed it from Latvian bur̃kā̃ns (“carrot”) – see it for more theories and cognates.
Ultimately from Latvian latvis. The e-vocalism might be generalized from the adjective lettisch (lättisch).
